content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Office and the Project
content_sections.text: The Office of the Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Jharkhand, Ranchi is an office of the Department of Forest, Environment & Climate Change, Government of Jharkhand, located at Van Bhawan, Doranda, Ranchi-834002. The posts are for the project "Identifications and mapping of Candidate Plus Trees and Seed Production Areas of indigenous tree species in Jharkhand and subsequent establishment of seed testing lab and seed processing Unit, (CPT's)", which has a project period of 4 years. Of the two Senior Project Associate posts and the two Project Associate posts, one each is for the Seed Processing Unit and one each for the Seed Testing Lab.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Essential educational qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture (Seed Science & Technology/Plant Breeding) OR M.Sc. in Forestry/M.Sc. in Botany with experience in Seed Science & Technology. First Class or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average. Candidates with 3 years bachelor's + 2 years master's must have UGC/ CSIR/ ICAR/ ICFRE NET or Ph.D. in above disciplines. Desirable qualification and experience: 4-year work experience in research and development in seed testing labs or seed processing units. Experience and willingness to work in forest with the forest communities. Good knowledge in drafting research articles, formal reports and computer application. Essential educational qualification: M.Sc. in Agriculture (Seed Science & Technology/Plant Breeding) OR M.Sc. in Forestry/M.Sc. in Botany with experience in Seed Science & Technology. First Class or 60% marks or equivalent grade. Desirable qualification and experience: 2 Year work experience in research and development in seed testing labs or seed processing units. Good understanding of forestry application and data compilation. Essential educational qualification: B.Sc in Agriculture Or B.Sc in Forestry Or B.Sc in Botany. Desirable qualification and experience: experience in seed collection, field data recording, computer operations, and MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point). Essential educational qualification: B.Sc in Agriculture Or B.Sc in Forestry Or B.Sc in Botany. Desirable qualification and experience: work experience in laboratory analysis of samples & data, data recording, analysis and computer knowledge. Candidate should be medically fit to work in different forest areas of the State of Jharkhand. Proficiency in computer application, especially MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point), may be an added benefit to the candidate. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.text: Candidates appear before a selection committee for an interview. A qualifying test (written) may be conducted before the interview. The notice does not describe the syllabus or the marks of this test.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Biodata Passport size photograph Original certificates Attested photocopies of all certificates, mark sheets, degree and testimonials

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reach Palas Sabhagar, Block -B, Van Bhavan, Doranda, Ranchi-834002 on 21/11/2026. Complete enrolment between 10:00 AM and 11:00 AM; candidates arriving after this time may not ordinarily be entertained. Sit the qualifying written test, if the office conducts one. Attend the interview, which starts at 11:30 AM.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The post is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project, with no provision for regularisation. The initial appointment will be for one year or up to the project period (as the case may be). The project period is 4 years. The Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation reserves the right to cancel or postpone the interview and to terminate the contract even before the completion of the project; no appeal shall be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the Jharkhand Forest Department walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 21 November 2026 at Palas Sabhagar, Office of Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Block -B, Van Bhavan, Doranda, Ranchi-834002 Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: Enrolment is from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM only, and the interview starts at 11:30 AM. Late arrivals may not ordinarily be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 6 posts: 1 Research Associate, 2 Senior Project Associates, 2 Project Associates and 1 Lab Technician.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Project Associate and Lab Technician?
faq.answer: Both posts need a B.Sc in Agriculture Or B.Sc in Forestry Or B.Sc in Botany.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 21/11/2026, the limit is 35 years for Research Associate, 28 years for Senior Project Associate and 30 years each for Project Associate and Lab Technician, with 4 years' relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/women as per approved rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly emoluments are Rs. 58,000/- (Research Associate), Rs. 42,000/- (Senior Project Associate), Rs. 25,000/- (Project Associate) and Rs. 20,000/- (Lab Technician), each plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, 18% HRA is paid in addition to the stated emoluments for every post. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring your biodata, a passport size photograph, original certificates and attested photocopies of all certificates, mark sheets, degree and testimonials.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an interview before a selection committee; a qualifying written test may be conducted before the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project with no provision for regularisation; the initial appointment is for one year or up to the project period.
